CRA:Annex I Part II (8).note: Security updates go out without delay, free of charge unless otherwise agreed for tailor-made products, with advisory messages telling users what to do. Also feeds the CRA Art. 12 presumption that a high-risk AI system meets AI Act Art. 15 cybersecurity.
